item.title: OpenBSD 7.8 Released
item.description:
📝 Fixes power button on various ThinkPads with AMD CPUs. o Improve mtx_enter() for machines with a huge number of CPUs. suspend sysctl that will force "S0ix" suspend and skip suspend of inteldrm(4) and amdgpu(4) such that the display remains on during suspend.
🔗 Read more: https://cdn.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/7.8/ANNOUNCEMENT

item.title: The Hidden Engineering of Niagara Falls
item.description:
📝 For a time, the Niagara Escarpment was a natural bottleneck between Lake Erie and Lake Ontario, preventing goods from moving directly between the upper lakes and the Atlantic. The Erie Canal solved the problem somewhat, starting in 1825, bypassing Lake Ontario. On the way downstream from Lake Erie to Lake Ontario, shipping traffic passes over aqueducts that pass over a natural river.
🔗 Read more: https://practical.engineering/blog/2025/10/21/the-hidden-engineering-of-niagara-falls

item.title: Cdb: Add support for cdb64
item.description:
📝 Replace various uint32, fmt, scan functions with num functions. Eliminate some wrappers: str_len, alloc, uint32, exit, error, systype. Tweak code to avoid -Wall complaints.
🔗 Read more: https://cdb.cr.yp.to/download.html
